entries.en: to trust in someone; to rely on a person
entries.notes: R 栏末字 xîn 与 H「人」不合（疑「心」之误记），H/M 两栏仍互证「倚傍人」。

entries.en: to rely on, to lean upon (someone)
entries.notes: H 怙/恬 存疑，M「cōû」与「怙」音合，取「怙」义。

entries.en: 〔original damaged; gloss uncertain〕
entries.notes: L 词头残缺（confiar de…ura con），H/M/R 虽存「滿目 moā-ba̍k」，与「信任」义的对应无法定夺。

entries.en: 〔original damaged; gloss uncertain〕
entries.notes: 汉字与两栏音写全空，仅存西语「Conformar y aprobar」，无对音可据。

entries.en: to confiscate
to confiscate for the King (into the royal treasury)
to candy, to make confections
entries.notes: H「碏」形义可疑（疑 碏/硝 之混），M「côg」为记音，义从西语 confitar。

entries.en: confects; candied sweets
entries.notes: H 首字「碏」存疑，义据西语 confites（糖果蜜饯）。

entries.en: sugar flowers; sugar confections

entries.zh: 制作茶点甜食的人，糖食师傅
entries.en: confectioner, maker of sweetmeats
entries.notes: H 第三字 茶/菓 存疑；「做茶料」指制茶食甜点，与 confitero 相合。

entries.en: 〔original damaged; gloss uncertain〕
to conform to; to follow (something else)
to agree with; to match (a likeness)
entries.notes: H「通」对西语 parecido 只能解作「相通、相合」，语义系推度。

entries.zh: 顺从他人意见，与人意相合
entries.en: to agree with another's opinion; to defer to it
entries.notes: H 合/台 存疑，M「hap」证成「合」；ageno 即 ajeno（他人的）。

entries.en: to conform (to what is written); to agree
entries.notes: H 合/台 存疑；vt 读作 ut（如、依照）。

entries.en: to conform to the former way; to follow precedent
to follow the previous (as before)
according to what is written; by the written word
to harmonize the will; to reconcile
entries.notes: H 和/扣 存疑，M/R 两栏均作「和」；boluntad 即 voluntad（意愿）。

entries.en: conformable; consonant, harmonious
according to that; leaning on, depending on
entries.notes: M 栏音标 T99 污损，L 为残句「conforme aeso」，仅能解作「依、靠」。
